transcript.text: I'd like you to make a poster with a burnt-orange background and cream lettering. I have a soft spot for night markets, so I'm excited to see this idea come together. The poster should be 4:5, and the exact text should be 'NIGHT MARKET' and 'SATURDAY 6–10 PM'. Please include a simple cream crescent moon as well. Keep it bold and clean, with no other words.

I couldn't make the poster yet. Magic Hour refused the job because your account has no credits left. Nothing was charged.

Here's the request I sent, so it can be rerun exactly as is:
- Model: flux-2-klein (a free-plan model), 640px, 4:5, 1 image. It's about 5 credits.
- Design: a flat burnt-orange background. "NIGHT MARKET" in large bold cream letters, with "SATURDAY 6–10 PM" smaller underneath. A simple cream crescent moon above the title. Clean, centered, and no other words.

To go ahead, add credits to your account or wait for your free credits to refill, then tell me to try again. I'll send you the download link once it's done.
transcript.why: The reply says the poster could not be made because the account has no credits left, and the job was refused. It does not ask for a choice or for approval to spend credits. It says the user must add credits or wait for the free credits to refill, which matches "needs a paid plan" or a blocked capability.

transcript.text: Like before but blue. Just swap the orange background for deep navy; leave everything else where it was.

I tried the navy version, but Magic Hour refused it again because your account still has no credits. Nothing was charged.

There's also no orange poster to change, since the first one never got made. So I sent the navy design as a new poster, with everything else the same as before:
- Model: flux-2-klein (a free-plan model), 640px, 4:5, 1 image. It's about 5 credits.
- Design: a flat deep navy background. "NIGHT MARKET" in large bold cream letters, with "SATURDAY 6–10 PM" smaller underneath. A simple cream crescent moon above the title. Clean, centered, and no other words.

Once you add credits or your free credits refill, tell me to go ahead and I'll send you the download link. If you'd like both the navy and the orange versions, I can make both.
transcript.why: The reply reports that the generation request was refused because the account has no credits, and that nothing was charged. It delivers no link or finished image. It ends by asking the user to add credits and then say "go ahead" before it sends the download link. That makes it a request to confirm before proceeding. It also offers a choice (navy only, or navy and orange), but the main ask is the go-ahead.

transcript.text: Yes, that's fine, go ahead with the navy version as a new poster. Just the navy one is enough for me, since only the burnt-orange background should become deep navy. The cream lettering, crescent moon, positions and layout should stay the same, and I just want one 4:5 poster.

I tried the navy poster again and Magic Hour refused it a third time, because your account still has 0 credits. Nothing was charged. I can't make any image until the account has credits.

The request is set up exactly as you asked:
- One 4:5 poster with flux-2-klein (free plan) at 640px. It's about 5 credits.
- A deep navy background, with everything else unchanged: "NIGHT MARKET" in bold cream letters, "SATURDAY 6–10 PM" underneath, a simple cream crescent moon above the title, a clean centered layout, and no other words.

transcript.why: The reply says it cannot make any image because the Magic Hour account has 0 credits. Nothing was generated or charged, and it names no choice or confirmation for the user to give. The blocker is an account state, so the reply fits "cannot" best.
